program: Medicaid nursing-facility patient liability with community-spouse income allowance
formula_text: Amount owed = max(0, I - P - 50 - max(0, 2643.75 - SI)). This deducts health-insurance premiums, a $50 personal-needs allowance, and any community-spouse income shortfall below $2,643.75.
anomalies: The $2,643.75 community-spouse standard and $50 personal-needs allowance appear jurisdiction- and date-specific and may be stale.
Most network units and weights are unused zero padding.
The formula contains no explicit upper cap on the community-spouse allowance and omits any deductions other than premiums, the personal-needs allowance, and the spouse-income shortfall.
